exceptions.reason: Build-time only: this copy (4.0.7) is used by vite 8 (a desktop devDependency that bundles the app with electron-vite, not shipped in it), vitest/tinyglobby/fdir in the test runs, and expo 58 -> @expo/cli and @expo/metro-config in the mobile app's development server. The ReDoS needs a crafted extglob pattern with a repeated single-branch group; every pattern matched here comes from configuration files this repository owns, on the developer's or CI machine, never from outside input. picomatch 4.0.7 is the latest release and the advisory covers every version up to it (no patched release exists). Remove this exception when a patched picomatch is published.
